pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarā purāṇarājorodhā bhikkhunīsu pabbajitā hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.3: aññatarā bhikkhunī anabhiratiyā pīḷitā yena sā bhikkhunī tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuniṃ etadavoca:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.8: atha kho sā bhikkhunī tassā bhikkhuniyā jatumaṭṭakaṃ ācikkhi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.9: atha kho sā bhikkhunī jatumaṭṭakaṃ ādiyitvā dhovituṃ vissaritvā ekamantaṃ chaḍḍesi.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.13: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.15: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhunī jatumaṭṭakaṃ ādiyīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.18: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhunī jatumaṭṭakaṃ ādiyissati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:1.20: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc4:2.4: samphassaṃ sādiyanti antamaso uppalapattampi muttakaraṇaṃ paveseti āpatti pācittiyassa.
